text: 0147 found one slip of the chisel, the S at 33, would bring K1 and K2's own method back at key length 19. That case is judged by English, after checking the search on planted messages with the same slip.
Five planted texts with a slip at 33, each against four copies keeping the known places; K4 against twelve. One planted text came back whole (97 of 97); the others got 32-38 letters right.
Only 3 of 5 planted texts beat all their copies (bar 4): the search is too weak here, so the cell stays blocked whatever K4 does (seventh of 13).
